description.value: SpearHead Winery is an award-winning Kelowna estate winery specializing in single-vineyard Pinot Noir from the Central Okanagan Valley, led by winemaker Grant Stanley who brings experience from New Zealand, Oregon, and BC. The winery earned the 2024 Best Performing Winery and Winery of the Year honours and offers tastings, a wine shop, wine club memberships, and a private events venue. Situated on Spiers Road in the heart of Okanagan wine country, it makes a natural destination stop on a cycling wine tour through the Kelowna region.
